verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents ad hoc querying through a visual builder plus PromQL and ClickHouse SQL in the Metrics Explorer, and offers attribute-based search, filtering and analysis for traces and logs. Its Agent Skills can also generate ClickHouse queries over traces, logs and metrics. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that a query language (not just filters) covers logs and traces, a first-party query-syntax reference in the pack, and independent hands-on corroboration.
